commands.name: build apk
commands.description: Build the debug APK and copy it into dist/<version>
commands.command: .\gradlew.bat :android:assembleDebug --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $version = ((Select-String -Path build.gradle -Pattern "version = '([^']+)'").Matches[0].Groups[1].Value); $apk = Get-ChildItem 'android\build\outputs\apk\debug' -Filter *.apk | Select-Object -First 1; $dir = "dist\$version"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; $out = Join-Path $dir "petals-$version-debug.apk"; Copy-Item $apk.FullName $out -Force; Write-Host "APK: $out"

commands.name: build distributable
commands.description: Build the desktop fat jar and copy it into dist/<version>
commands.command: .\gradlew.bat :desktop:dist --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $version = ((Select-String -Path build.gradle -Pattern "version = '([^']+)'").Matches[0].Groups[1].Value); $jar = "desktop\build\libs\desktop-$version.jar"; $dir = "dist\$version"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Copy-Item $jar (Join-Path $dir 'FaesFeisty.jar') -Force; Copy-Item $jar (Join-Path $dir "petals-$version-desktop.jar") -Force; Write-Host "JAR: $(Join-Path $dir 'FaesFeisty.jar')"

commands.name: build web
commands.description: Transpile the HTML/TeaVM build and zip it into dist/<version>
commands.command: .\gradlew.bat :web:buildJavaScript --console=plain; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $version = ((Select-String -Path build.gradle -Pattern "version = '([^']+)'").Matches[0].Groups[1].Value); $web = 'web\build\dist\webapp'; $dir = "dist\$version"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; $zip = Join-Path $dir "FaesFeisty-web-$version.zip"; if (Test-Path $zip) { Remove-Item $zip -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path "$web\*" -DestinationPath $zip; Write-Host "WEB: $zip"; Write-Host "Serve with: .\gradlew.bat :web:runWeb"
